name: Spin Class
summary:
Welcome to Spin Class – Part of Your Ultimate Virtual Fitness Oasis on Meta!

Immerse yourself in the future of workouts with our groundbreaking VR app. Join instructor-led spin classes, embark on interactive fitness adventures, and connect with a vibrant global community. Elevate your routine with a customizable and stunning studio environment with spatial audio.  All you need is a stationary bike and your headset.
